events.title: Dev update: chips, boss entrances and a few things you told us
events.summary: Hey everyone, a quick note from the workshop before Next Fest. The demo just got a fresh build: Enemies now drop chips. Drag one onto a glowing socket and that tower gets a small boost for the rest of the mission. Bosses announce themselves properly now: the portal shakes, a shadow sweeps the field, and then they break through. Burning, frozen, zapped or marked enemies finally look like it. Thanks to everyone who reported things on Discord — the "Homecoming" achievement can be earned in the demo

events.title: Next Fest demo: eight missions, boss swarms and the full map editor
events.summary: What's new for Next Fest Three stars per mission — and a reason to come back for them Card picks at waves 3, 5 and 7, plus tower combos that trigger SYNERGY Boss waves now bring real swarms: escorts in packs, then reinforcements New impacts for every tower and orbital ability, new exit portals with light pillars Toodry is now properly dry: the lakes are cracked salt flats What's in the demo Campaign missions 1–8 on the planets Overgroan and Toodry, seven towers The full map editor with share cod

events.title: The demo is out — and it's the whole campaign
events.summary: The demo is live It's not a slice. The demo has the complete 16-mission campaign — every planet, every tower, every boss. Most demos give you two levels; this one gives you the whole story. Every map is a code The map editor is in there too. Draw paths, place water and obstacles, decide where towers can be built — then hit save and the whole map turns into a short block of text. Paste it into a chat, someone else pastes it into their editor, and they're playing exactly your map. No accounts, no
